Seasonal campaigns

Advent Calendar 2026

One seasonal initiative across all 14 brands, in two parts. Each brand has its own entry banner on its homepage, designed in that brand’s world. The banner leads to the Advent landing page: a shared calendar of 31 doors, one for every day of December, branded for each site.

Entry banners

Fourteen banners from one brief. The artwork is built around each brand’s own character, colours and setting, and the headline is written in four variations. Filter by headline to compare how the same line was carried across brands.

    Landing page

    “31 Days. 31 Exclusive Rooms. One Extraordinary December.”

    Countdown
    A countdown to the first door, which opens on Tuesday 1 December.
    The corridor
    31 numbered doors along a lit art-deco corridor, arranged around a central chandelier.
    Progress
    A tracker showing how many of the 31 rooms the player has explored.
    Door states
    Each door is marked as open tonight, ready to open, explored or sealed.

      Seasonal campaigns

      Christmas 2026

      A separate seasonal landing page for the same 14 brands, built on one shared template and branded for each site. It leads with the Christmas welcome offer and takes the visitor from a festive opening, through a gift reveal, to sign-up.

      How the page unfolds

      Three moments from top to bottom of the page, shown on the 4Crowns version.

        All 14 brand versions

        Select a page to enlarge it, or open the live page.

          Promotional landing pages

          Dedicated promotional pages for acquisition. Each one presents the brand’s full welcome package, from the headline offer down to the four deposit rewards and their bonus codes. The two pages share one structure and carry separate art direction.

          Interactive video experience

          A welcome landing page for Union Jackpots built around a Blings video. The video is the page’s main stage: it opens the experience, greets the visitor and plays beside the rewards it introduces.

          1. 1The invitation

            Chapter I, “The Calling Card”, opens with “You’re invited.” The visitor knocks on the door to enter, with sound or without.

          2. 2The welcome

            The Gentleman appears in a portrait video frame and greets the visitor on screen: “Good evening, Guest. Welcome to Union Jackpots.”

          3. 3The rewards

            Beside the video, the four deposit rewards are revealed, from 400% up to £2,500 to 150% up to £1,000, each with a bonus code to copy.

          4. 4The chapters

            A chapter bar under the video divides the story into five parts.

          5. 5The claim

            A single call to action, “Claim reward one”, sits under the rewards.

          Interactive promotional widgets

          Daily Bonus widget

          A self-contained slot machine for the daily bonus. The platform supplies the copy, the twelve prize options and the winning result; the widget handles the spin, the reveal and the claim. Its colours are set as theme variables, so it can be re-branded per site.

          Try it: pull the lever, tap the reels or press Spin now, then claim the prize. This is a demo with sample rewards. The claim callback and platform events are switched off, so nothing is sent anywhere.

          Animated reels

          Three reels wind up, spin, stop in sequence and settle with a small bounce. The last reel is highlighted while the result lands.

          Interactive spinning

          The lever can be dragged or tapped, and the reels and Spin button also start a spin.

          Prize reveal

          The winning row lights up on the pay line and the prize amount counts up in the result card.

          Claim

          Claiming confirms the reward with an animated check. In production this step calls the platform’s callback.

          Sound and effects

          Sounds are synthesised in the browser with no audio files, with a mute button. Confetti and coins are drawn on a canvas layer.

          Responsive behaviour

          Side by side on desktop and stacked on mobile. Prize text scales to fit each tile, and reduced-motion settings are respected.

          Delivered projects

          Across 14 brands: 14 entry banners, 28 seasonal landing pages, 2 promotional pages, 1 video experience and 1 interactive widget.
